title: A New Heart and a New Spirit

questions.question: Who is Ezekiel commanded to prophesy to at the beginning of chapter 36?
options: The mountains of Israel
The rivers of Babylon
The kings of the earth
The priests of the temple
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:1 (ESV): "And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord."

questions.question: What did the enemy say against the mountains of Israel?
options: "Aha! and, 'The ancient heights have become our possession'"
"Let us tear them down to the sea."
"Fire shall consume their peaks."
"No man shall ever dwell there again."
questions.correctAnswer: "Aha! and, 'The ancient heights have become our possession'"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:2 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: Because the enemy said of you, 'Aha!' and, 'The ancient heights have become our possession,'"

questions.question: Because the nations made Israel a possession and a laughingstock, what did God speak in His hot jealousy against the rest of the nations and Edom?
options: "I speak in my hot jealousy against the rest of the nations... who gave my land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt..."
"I will rain fire and sulfur on them forever."
"I will make them slaves to the Israelites."
"I will turn their rivers to blood."
questions.correctAnswer: "I speak in my hot jealousy against the rest of the nations... who gave my land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:5 (ESV): "therefore thus says the Lord God: Surely I have spoken in my hot jealousy against the rest of the nations and against all Edom, who gave my land to themselves as a possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt..."

questions.question: What promise does God make to the mountains of Israel regarding fruitfulness?
options: "But you, O mountains of Israel, shall shoot forth your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel, for they will soon come home."
"Your heights will yield gold and silver."
"No trees shall grow, only wheat."
"The desert will bloom like a rose."
questions.correctAnswer: "But you, O mountains of Israel, shall shoot forth your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel, for they will soon come home."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:8 (ESV): "But you, O mountains of Israel, shall shoot forth your branches and yield your fruit to my people Israel, for they will soon come home."

questions.question: What will God multiply upon the mountains of Israel?
options: People, the whole house of Israel, all of it. The cities shall be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt
Flocks of sheep with golden fleece
Wolves and bears to protect the land from foreigners
Lions to guard the borders
questions.correctAnswer: People, the whole house of Israel, all of it. The cities shall be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:10 (ESV): "And I will multiply people on you, the whole house of Israel, all of it. The cities shall be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt."

questions.question: What was the reason the house of Israel was initially cast out of their land?
options: They defiled it by their ways and their deeds
They were not strong enough to defeat Babylon
They refused to pay the temple tax
They built a tower to reach the heavens
questions.correctAnswer: They defiled it by their ways and their deeds
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:17 (ESV): "Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and their deeds."

questions.question: When Israel came to the nations, what did they profane?
options: God's holy name
The Sabbath day
The temple treasures
The covenant of Abraham
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:20 (ESV): "But when they came to the nations, wherever they came, they profaned my holy name, in that people said of them, 'These are the people of the Lord, and yet they had to go out of his land.'"

questions.question: Why does God say He will vindicate the holiness of His great name?
options: "It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned..."
"Because you have cried out to me in repentance."
"Because the seventy years are fulfilled."
"To prove the Babylonian gods false."
questions.correctAnswer: "It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:22 (ESV): "Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God: It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am about to act, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations to which you came."

questions.question: What will God do to cleanse the people?
options: "I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you."
"I will bathe you in the Jordan River seven times."
"I will send fire from heaven to burn away your sins."
"I will wipe away your tears with my own hands."
questions.correctAnswer: "I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:25 (ESV): "I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you."

questions.question: In verses 26-27, what will God give Israel, and what will He remove from them?
options: Give a new heart and a new spirit; remove the heart of stone and give a heart of flesh
Give a new law on stone tablets; remove the broken tablets
Give unparalleled wealth; remove their enemies
Give wings like eagles; remove their heavy burdens
questions.correctAnswer: Give a new heart and a new spirit; remove the heart of stone and give a heart of flesh
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:26 (ESV): "And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put within you. And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh."

questions.question: What will God put within the people to cause them to walk in His statutes and be careful to obey His rules?
options: His Spirit
His Word
His Angel
His Fear
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:27 (ESV): "And I will put my Spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes and be careful to obey my rules."

questions.question: When God summons the grain and makes it abundant and lays no famine upon them, what will the people remember?
options: Their evil ways and their deeds that were not good, and they will loathe themselves for their iniquities and their abominations
The days of Egypt and the slavery they endured
The songs of David their king
The covenant of the rainbow
questions.correctAnswer: Their evil ways and their deeds that were not good, and they will loathe themselves for their iniquities and their abominations
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:31 (ESV): "Then you will remember your evil ways, and your deeds that were not good, and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and your abominations."

questions.question: What will the desolate land become like when it is rebuilt?
options: Like the garden of Eden
Like the plains of Mamre
Like the mountains of Ararat
Like the hanging gardens of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:35 (ESV): "And they will say, 'This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden...'"

questions.question: What will the nations that are left all around know when the ruined places are rebuilt and the desolate land is replanted?
options: "I am the Lord; I have rebuilt the ruined places and replanted that which was desolate. I am the Lord; I have spoken, and I will do it."
"The God of Israel was just sleeping."
"The Jews are the mightiest warriors."
"Babylon was weaker than we thought."
questions.correctAnswer: "I am the Lord; I have rebuilt the ruined places and replanted that which was desolate. I am the Lord; I have spoken, and I will do it."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:36 (ESV): "Then the nations that are left all around you shall know that I am the Lord; I have rebuilt the ruined places and replanted that which was desolate. I am the Lord; I have spoken, and I will do it."

questions.question: Because the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people, like the flock for sacrifices at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, what will they know?
options: That I am the Lord
That the temple will stand forever
That a new Messiah is born
That Egypt will serve them
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 36:38 (ESV): "Like the flock for sacrifices, like the flock at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the Lord."

key_verse_text: "And I will give you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put within you. And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh."
